import pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
# load ref
ann_raw=pd.read_excel('supp_data_1_6.xlsx',sheet_name='Supplementary Data 4',header=None)
ann=ann_raw.iloc[:,1:5].copy(); ann.columns=['metacell','cell_type','dev_layer','reclustering']
ann=ann[pd.to_numeric(ann['metacell'],errors='coerce').notna()].copy(); ann['metacell']=ann['metacell'].astype(int)
raw=pd.read_excel('source_data.xlsx',sheet_name='Figure 1c',header=None)
row_gene=raw.index[raw.iloc[:,1].eq('Gene')][0]
head=raw.iloc[row_gene,1:].tolist()
expr=raw.iloc[row_gene+1:,1:].dropna(subset=[1]).copy(); expr.columns=head
expr=expr[expr['Gene'].astype(str).str.startswith('BLAG')].set_index('Gene')
expr.columns=[int(float(c)) for c in expr.columns]
expr=expr.astype(float)
# Collapse fine metacell annotation to task labels
map_ct={
 'endoderm':'endoderm',
 'endostyle':'endostyle_csg',
 'epidermal neural 1':'epidermal_neural',
 'epidermal neural 2':'epidermal_neural',
 'anterior epidermis':'epidermis',
 'posterior epidermis':'epidermis',
 'mesodermal notochord':'mesodermal_notochord',
 'muscular somites':'muscular_somites',
 'neural':'neural',
 'neural like 1':'neural_like',
 'neural like 2':'neural_like',
 'putative neuro/endo':'putative_neuro_endo',
 'somite':'somite',
 'tailbud':'tailbud',
 'tailbud neural':'tailbud_neural',
}
ann2=ann[ann.cell_type.isin(map_ct)].copy(); ann2['label']=ann2.cell_type.map(map_ct)
ref={}
for label, sub in ann2.groupby('label'):
    ref[label]=expr[sub.metacell.tolist()].mean(axis=1)
ref=pd.DataFrame(ref)
# load query
df=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.rna.q1.tsv.gz',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
labels=list(df.columns)
common=df.index.intersection(ref.index)
print('common', len(common))
# try transformations for query/ref
transforms=[]
transforms.append(('log1p_vs_logFC', np.log1p(df.loc[common]), np.log2(ref.loc[common]+1e-9)))
transforms.append(('log1p_vs_FC', np.log1p(df.loc[common]), ref.loc[common]))
# fold change query within query: divide by gene median/mean
q=df.loc[common].replace(0, np.nan)
q_fc_median=df.loc[common].div(df.loc[common].median(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan), axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).fillna(0)
q_fc_mean=df.loc[common].div(df.loc[common].mean(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)
transforms.append(('q_logFCmedian_vs_logFC', np.log2(q_fc_median+1e-6), np.log2(ref.loc[common]+1e-6)))
transforms.append(('q_FCmean_vs_FC', q_fc_mean, ref.loc[common]))
for name,qmat,rmat in transforms:
    # select variable genes maybe
    for subset in ['all','var5000','marker_ref_fc1.5','marker_query_top']:
        genes=common
        if subset=='var5000':
            v=(qmat.var(axis=1)+rmat.var(axis=1)).sort_values(ascending=False)
            genes=v.head(5000).index
        elif subset=='marker_ref_fc1.5':
            mx=ref.loc[common].max(axis=1); med=ref.loc[common].median(axis=1)
            genes=mx[mx>=1.5].index
        elif subset=='marker_query_top':
            # genes with high max/min query FC
            fc=df.loc[common].div(df.loc[common].mean(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan), axis=0).fillna(0)
            score=fc.max(axis=1)
            genes=score.sort_values(ascending=False).head(5000).index
        C=pd.DataFrame(index=labels, columns=labels, dtype=float)
        for ql in labels:
            for rl in labels:
                a=qmat.loc[genes,ql].astype(float).values
                b=rmat.loc[genes,rl].astype(float).values
                mask=np.isfinite(a)&np.isfinite(b)
                if mask.sum()<10: C.loc[ql,rl]=np.nan
                else: C.loc[ql,rl]=np.corrcoef(a[mask],b[mask])[0,1]
        ri,ci=linear_sum_assignment(-C.values)
        assignment={labels[i]:labels[j] for i,j in zip(ri,ci)}
        total=C.values[ri,ci].sum()
        mism=[(q,r,C.loc[q,r]) for q,r in assignment.items() if q"'!=r]
        print('"'\\n',name, subset, 'n', len(genes), 'assign_total', round(total,3), 'mism', mism)
        print(C.round(3).to_string())
        # Evaluate pair swaps: identity total vs all single pair swaps where observed q label maps to ref label? If two labels swapped in data then best assignment has q label -> other ref.
        ident=sum(C.loc[l,l] for l in labels)
        best=None
        for a,b in itertools.combinations(labels,2):
            score=ident-C.loc[a,a]-C.loc[b,b]+C.loc[a,b]+C.loc[b,a]
            if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,a,b)
        print('identity',round(ident,3),'best_swap',best[1],best[2],round(best[0],3),'gain',round(best[0]-ident,3))
PY"

head=raw.iloc[row,1:].tolist()

map_ct={'endoderm':'endoderm','endostyle':'endostyle_csg','epidermal neural 1':'epidermal_neural','epidermal neural 2':'epidermal_neural','anterior epidermis':'epidermis','posterior epidermis':'epidermis','mesodermal notochord':'mesodermal_notochord','muscular somites':'muscular_somites','neural':'neural','neural like 1':'neural_like','neural like 2':'neural_like','putative neuro/endo':'putative_neuro_endo','somite':'somite','tailbud':'tailbud','tailbud neural':'tailbud_neural'}
